bullets.text: The Supreme Court ordered the demolition of twenty houses in Thiruvallur after cancelling the pattas issued on water body land, and the office should monitor eviction actions.
Anbumani Ramadoss urged the Tamil Nadu government to notify the Pallikaranai marshland and release an integrated management plan, and the office should watch for environmental policy updates.
Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong and Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay opened CapitaLand's first Chennai data centre, highlighting growing economic ties that the office should support.
Equinix India plans to expand its data centre capacity from twenty megawatts to seventy megawatts driven by AI, and the portfolio team should track infrastructure growth.
Oneindia Tamil criticized the TVK government over un desilted canals and urban flooding during the northeast monsoon, and the office should prepare responses to political criticisms.

stories.title: Equinix India plans 70 MW data centre expansion driven by AI
takeaways: Equinix India plans to scale its data centre capacity from 20 MW to 70 MW.

The opposition criticized the TVK government for failing to prepare properly for the season.
